name: Vishnu Mandir
town_description: Purnia (also Purnea) is a city in northeastern Bihar and the headquarters of Purnia district and division. An educational and commercial hub of the Seemanchal-Kosi region, it is nicknamed 'Mini Darjeeling' and takes its name from goddess Puran Devi (Puran Aranya).

travel.airport: Nearest commercial airport: Bagdogra (IXB), about 160-170 km by road; Purnia's own airport is under development.
travel.railway: Purnea Junction, a major railhead on the Katihar-Samastipur section, lies within the city.
travel.road: NH 27 and NH 31 pass through Purnia; well connected by bus, auto-rickshaw and taxi.
